injury.short_comment: Lendeborg (foot) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

roster.name: Kristaps Porzingis
roster.name_zh: 克里斯塔普斯·波尔津吉斯

injury.short_comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
